sections.executiveSummary:
Kauri Joinery has asked Harbour Light Tech to look after IT for its 12 staff and to set up a reliable network at the workshop. This proposal covers both, starting on 1 December.

We will set up the network first, so that support starts on equipment we installed and know well. From then on, our team handles day-to-day support for everyone, from a forgotten password to a laptop that won't start.

Support costs {{pricing.monthlyRecurring}} per month over {{pricing.termMonths}} months, and the network setup is a one-off {{pricing.oneTime}}. The Investment section shows each line.
sections.understanding:
Kauri Joinery has 12 staff and wants two things: IT support it can call on, and a network that works across the office and the workshop.

We understand the priorities to be:

- Help for all 12 people when something stops them working.
- A dependable network, set up properly once.
- Everything in place from 1 December.

If we've misunderstood anything, tell us and we'll change the proposal before you sign.
sections.solution:
We propose two services.

- **Network setup**: we install and configure the network once, and document it so that anyone on our team can support it.
- **Managed support** for all 12 staff: one number to call, remote fixes, and visits when a problem needs someone on site.

The setup comes first, in the last weeks of November, so that support starts on 1 December with a network we know well and nothing left over from before.

scope.notes: Covers all 12 staff from 1 December, during business hours.
A one-off project at the office and workshop, finished before support starts.

timeline.label: Network setup
timeline.detail: Install, configure and document the network.

whyUs.intro: We are a small local team. The people who set up your network are the same people who answer when you call, so nothing gets lost in a handover.

assumptions: Kauri Joinery will give us access to the office and workshop during the setup weeks.
Prices are based on 12 staff; changes in numbers are billed from the following month.
notIncluded: New computers, phones or software licences.
